claim_boundary: This artifact now freezes every ORN_DA2 and DA2_lPN identity present in the exact FlyWire v783 v2.1.0 annotation table. It reconciles 39 annotated ORN_DA2 records and 11 DA2_lPN records, while explicitly retaining the publication-vs-table count gap, one unresolved OSN side, and the unpublished root ID of the manually identified additional afferent. It is not yet a complete 41-cell Or56a cohort and cannot authorize confirmatory connectivity or dynamics claims.
